citation: Kasten, F., Young, A. T. (1989). Revised optical air mass tables and approximation formula
note: The abstract says only that an error in a widely used air-mass table is corrected on the ISO Standard Atmosphere (1972) and its approximation formula revised; abstract only. Citation and DOI match, but the coefficients 0.50572, 96.07995 and 1.6364 are inside the paper. The earlier [Kasten 1965](https://consensus.app/papers/details/w:827c6d5f-877e-4980-9e73-13ce028ad0c9/?utm_source=claude_desktop) formula has the same form in solar altitude, 1 / (sin γ + a (γ + b)^-c), with older constants.
found: Kasten, F. and Young, A. T. 1989, [Revised optical air mass tables and approximation formula](https://consensus.app/papers/details/w:234d5d0c-0006-4fd2-8b6a-a1c18842d8fc/?utm_source=claude_desktop), Applied Optics, 15 November 1989, volume and pages not shown, DOI 10.1364/AO.28.004735
